128070.synopsis:
Gu Huaichen and I went from school uniforms to wedding gowns.

I dragged my feet, refusing to leave.
Until I saw him and my best friend walking out of a hotel together.
I finally signed the divorce papers.
After the divorce, I stumbled upon their wedding photos online.
She captioned it: [I was once your bridesmaid, today I am your bride.] 
I stared at the screen, stunned.
Lowering my head, I asked the man beneath me:

129350.synopsis:
Voice actor Gu Baiqing wakes up one day to find himself transmigrated—into none other than the Master shou character he once voiced.
Shocking! This was that ultra-risque novel full of “pushing-the-limits” plots and chapter after chapter of predatory tension!
In the original story, his disciple Mo Xuanli, after turning demonic, was consumed with all kinds of unspeakable desires for his master Gu Baiqing— And he acted on every single one of them.
He tricked him body and soul, leading to a torturous love-hate relationship filled with mutual obsession and emotional wreckage.
So now, every time Gu Baiqing sees his gentle and obedient disciple, he shivers.
In Gu Baiqing’s eyes, Mo Xuanli is nothing but a vicious wolf wearing a loyal dog’s skin—always secretly thinking about betraying and dominating his master.
Determined not to fall into the same plot as the Master in the novel, Gu Baiqing is determined to not bend.
In these types of Master novels, the masters always end up doomed because they’re too good to their beautiful, strong, and tragically tormented disciples.
So—
While others offer hands-on teaching, he lets his disciple run wild.
While others shield their disciples, he stays uninvolved.
While others take the punishment for their disciples, he grabs the whip and personally dishes it out.
He absolutely refuses to let Mo Xuanli say one good thing about him.He must crush any improper thoughts in the bud.
Of course, he can’t go too far. A blackened Mo Xuanli is seriously scary.
All Gu Baiqing wants is to peacefully be a cold, aloof, and proper teacher while completing the system’s cultivation task. Really, it’s a legit teaching task!
But why is Mo Xuanli looking at him more and more strangely, with eyes full of complicated emotion, as if he’s constantly holding something back?
Until one day, Gu Baiqing is hit with a horrifying realization…. He may have transmigrated into the wrong book.
This is actually a BG (boy-girl) world?! Mo Xuanli never had any betrayal or taboo thoughts—he’s truly a model disciple, loyal, pure, and filial!
Overjoyed, Gu Baiqing thinks he no longer needs to worry about being “eyed” by his disciple.
That is… until Mo Xuanli, finally pushed to the brink by his master’s constant cold-and-hot treatment, eyes reddening, snaps.
The loyal dog bares its fangs, traps his master, and lowers his head to bite at his nape with a hoarse voice laced with danger and heat:
“Master, you can treat me worse if you want, I won’t get mad. But if you ever abandon me… I’ll make you pay. Severely.”
Gu Baiqing, who just ditched Mo Xuanli five minutes ago: He’s got a soft temper. Probably just bluffing with words, right?
First night of rebellion: This disciple is not normal!!
Nth night, master’s back injury: Are you really sure I transmigrated into the wrong book?!
[Content Warnings / Reader Notes] :
Both leads are physically and emotionally clean. 1v1 pairing.
Alt-universe xianxia (cultivation world), non-traditional setting.
Writing is average; modern expressions and slang appear; not a serious historical tone.
Classic transmigration plot. Don’t compare it with other stories.
Drop it if it’s not your thing—no need to announce it.
Original title: 《Master Novels Don’t You Dare Use Tropes on Me》

133446.synopsis:
As the most talented prodigy of an era, having defeated all the fated competitors of this world, Mason Carter should have ascended to the position of emperor.

Unwilling to give up, Mason Carter hid in one great era after another, becoming the strongest of his time,
but still unable to align with the fate of heaven and achieve the Dao of the Emperor.
Yet, even the invincible emperors of the age could not attain immortality and eternal vision.
He could only travel to the far reaches of the universe in search of an ethereal path to immortality.
Aware that he might be targeted, Mason Carter began to conceal his identity, wandering through endless years to find a new path forward.
He was born in the ancient era, witnessing the rise of hundreds of emperors,
the battle of ten thousand races,
and the vastness of the Great Dao. 
He saw emperors fall with mournful cries, forbidden zones rise, and the supreme beings fall into deep slumber.
He also experienced the chaotic ancient era, dark turmoil, and the bloody battle of the stars.
The Great Dao withered, spiritual energy revived, and the age of magic waned…
Mason Carter observed the chaos of the mortal world, the rise and fall of the starry rivers, the alternation of eras,
and unwittingly became the greatest taboo of the world.
After endless years, when the world passages connected, and the battle of the heavens arrived,
Mason Carter’s eyes opened. With just a glance, he pierced through the ages, and with a single breath,
he obliterated the Great Dao.

150598.synopsis:
Qin Xiaoyou was a mischievous child who would run across the river every day after school to visit Mr. Li, who lived in a small Western-style house.
Mr. Li was a foreigner who enjoyed drinking coffee, growing roses, playing the piano, painting, and teaching Qin Xiaoyou foreign languages.
Although the villagers kept their distance from Mr. Li, Qin Xiaoyou adored him. However, a devastating flood wiped out the village, leaving countless families shattered and lives lost.
Thirty years later, Qin Xiaoyou opened his eyes to find himself lying in a strange coffin, his body still frozen in his teenage years.
Mr. Li stood beside the coffin, leaning down gently and extending a warm hand toward him.
“Welcome back, my little friend.”
Newly awakened, Qin Xiaoyou was ravenously hungry and thirsty. He stared at Mr. Li’s neck, unable to suppress the sharp fangs that emerged from his mouth.
Mr. Li gently stroked his fine hair.
“Little friend must learn patience.”
“I… I’m sorry… sob…”
“It’s okay for younglings to make mistakes sometimes. If you don’t know something, I can teach you.”
“Th-thank you, Mr. Li.”
“Wrong. I am your Guide.”
A new Blood Clan youngling arrived at Saint Grace Academy. Unlike the other elegant Blood Clan members, this youngling was mischievous, unruly, and astonishingly destructive. On his first day, he punched a Noble student, prompting the teacher to summon his guardian. Everyone waited eagerly for the spectacle.
When Mr. Li appeared at the Academy to collect his young charge, the crowd was stunned.
The Guide of this rustic Blood Clan youngling was none other than the King of the Blood Clan himself?
After becoming a Blood Clan member, Qin Xiaoyou had only one goal: to work hard, reach adulthood, marry Mr. Li, and ascend to the pinnacle of life.
The other Blood Clan members scoffed: “Wishful thinking! Once a Blood Clan member undergoes the First Embrace, they can never grow again.”
Later, Qin Xiaoyou not only grew, but his height also shot up to 1.8 meters.
The other Blood Clan members: …
Where did this atypical Blood Clan member come from? This defies all logic!
Sefrans was the King of the Blood Clan, having lived from ancient times to the modern era.
For the sake of an ancient pact, he had searched for millennia.
Just when he thought it was all a figment of his imagination, someone pointed him in the right direction.
Under the alias Mr. Li, he retreated to a remote, isolated mountain village, living a quiet life of raising a child, nurturing a little bat, and tending his garden.
Until a mountain flood submerged the village. Mr. Li took his First Embrace back to the Blood Clan Castle, offering him sanctuary and guiding his growth.
And the pact between them had only just begun…
★ Reading Guide ★
1. The male lead dotes on the male protagonist. 1v1, sweet romance.
2. This story is purely fictional! It’s not a traditional vampire story; the world-building is heavily based on original settings. The narrative blends a fictional setting with a touch of cyberpunk and a hint of mystery!
3. The main character will grow up. The early chapters focus on familial and platonic bonds; romantic development begins only after the main character reaches adulthood.

Xu Shenqing is the ‘devoted second male lead’ in a novel.

He must hand over his umbrella when the Protagonist (Bottom) is caught in a rainstorm and offer warmth and concern when they are sad—only to be rejected as a matter of course in the end.
It is all very formulaic, but Xu Shenqing has no other choice. He plays a ‘passerby A’ in this bustling world of romance, only occasionally feeling weary.
Though playing the devoted second lead every day isn’t easy, it’s alright—he has a brother.
His best friend, Wei Jin, is handsome, rich, an all-around cool guy, and incredibly loyal.
When Xu Shenqing hands his umbrella to the Protagonist, Wei Jin holds an umbrella over him to block the rain and pats his shoulder while sharing half an ice cream.
When Xu Shenqing acts discouraged by rejection, Wei Jin sighs loudly, looking truly sorry for him, and takes him to the French restaurant by the school gate.
When Xu Shenqing is tossing and turning over a text message (actually, he just can’t sleep because he drank too much Luckin Coffee), Wei Jin stays up to drink with him in silence. The night breeze seems to make his best friend’s gaze look just as sorrowful.
More than once, Xu Shenqing has marveled that having Wei Jin as a brother is enough for one lifetime.
Until one day, Xu Shenqing finally reaches the end of his exhausting, repetitive second lead task. He pretends to be heartbroken over his ‘lost love’ and gets dead drunk.
He was just about to lose consciousness—the wine was so fragrant and the night breeze so cool—when he felt Wei Jin’s body temperature, which was terrifyingly hot. The grip on his shoulder was tight, and Wei Jin’s smile was an act of forced, unrestrained ease:
“Hey… could you consider me instead?”
Xu Shenqing couldn’t hold it in, he almost choked on his wine.

202054.synopsis:
Yeonwoo, the illegitimate child of a member of the National Assembly, has been disguised as an adoptee and spent over thirteen years living under oppression and torment — but he has one dream.

203590.synopsis:
The moment Jiang Xia closed her eyes and opened them again, she found herself transported back to the 1980s.
She had become a freshly graduated police academy student from a vocational school, newly assigned as a police officer at a local police station.
To make matters worse, she was saddled with a Criminal Master System.
As long as she kept committing crimes and building a notorious reputation, the system would reward her with all kinds of criminal skills.
Looking at the Grandmaster-Level Pickpocketing skill the system had just awarded her, Jiang Xia nearly broke down.
What am I supposed to do with this? Compete with pickpockets to see who’s better at stealing?
She originally thought the system was completely useless.
Instead, it turned out to be incredibly effective for staking out and catching pickpockets.
The moment a suspect successfully lifted a wallet, Jiang Xia would pin them to the ground. Her hands moved faster than her brain, instinctively frisking the thief from head to toe with astonishing efficiency.
She uncovered every stash of stolen cash her colleagues had failed to notice and even slipped the freshly stolen money back into the victim’s pocket before anyone realized.
The veteran officer mentoring her watched her seamless, practiced movements and fell into deep thought.
“Xiao Xia… don’t you think your technique is a little… too professional?”
Jiang Xia: …
It’s all this damned system’s fault!
…
As time passed, Jiang Xia gradually unlocked even more abilities.
Trace Forgery allowed her to spot fake crime scenes at a glance and reconstruct what had really happened.
Counter-Surveillance let her predict a killer’s escape route in reverse.
Mastery of Homicide enabled her to identify suspects and mu*der weapons simply by examining wounds.
…
Using the very skills of criminals, she solved the most difficult cases.
But the more cases she cracked, the stranger the looks from her colleagues and superiors became.
How is it that Jiang Xia understands crime better than every criminal we’ve ever arrested?!
